title: Home on Geneva Street, The Paper Invasion & Fall Break
summary: After Isabel and Jordan share their first night together in the walk-out basement sanctuary at 414 Geneva Street, October brings two sudden remnants of Jordan's past: an IRS CP87A audit notice triggered by Aubrie Sinclair fraudulently claiming Jordan as a dependent on her tax return, and an I-64 East exit-ramp meltdown during the group's Fall Break foliage trip to Afton Mountain—followed by a 100.1°F catch-up immunization fever and an all-day basement marathon of the 12-hour Leviathan Cut of The Silver Gauntlet of Aethel.
